observed.caption: Sun partially behind clouds at dawn over rolling green hills with a red-tiled house and dense trees in the foreground.
observed.description: A wide elevated view shows a pale sky with scattered clouds and a bright sun low on the horizon partially obscured by cloud, casting soft light over distant rolling grassy hills and a valley. In the midground, scattered small buildings and trees are visible among greenery with faint utility poles and wires. In the foreground, dense dark green trees and foliage dominate the lower half, with a house featuring a red tiled roof and a small chimney visible on the left and a large leafy tree on the right, and a small white spherical lamp near the bottom edge.
